step_7.title: Correlation and Feature Relationship Analysis with ML Governance

scheduled_days_vs_delay.finding: Strong negative correlation (-0.370) between scheduled shipping days and late delivery. Orders scheduled for 1-day (First Class) or 2-day (Second Class) delivery have dramatically higher delay probabilities due to aggressive logistical SLAs.

discounts_vs_profit.finding: Discount rate exhibits negligible correlation with profit ratio (-0.0019) across normal orders, indicating DataCo pricing algorithms maintain consistent margins despite promotional discounting.

quantity_vs_profit.finding: Positive correlation (+0.091) between item quantity and total order profit, driven by linear gross margin accumulation.
